blocks.text: Sabz cells mein roshni (light) ki maujoodgi mein hone wali woh respiration jaisi sargarmi jis mein carbon dioxide nikalti hai, photorespiration kehlati hai. Aerobic respiration ki tarah is mein oxygen lagti hai aur CO₂ aur H₂O bante hain. Lekin photorespiration mein ATP nahin banta.

blocks.title: Yaad karein
blocks.text: Carbon fixation ke dauran rubisco CO₂ ke teen molecules ko RuBP ke teen molecules se jor kar 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) ke chhe molecules banata hai.
Photorespiration ka tareeqa (mechanism)

Hum jante hain ke RuBP carboxylase (rubisco) RuBP mein CO₂ jorta hai aur phosphoglyceric acid (phosphoglycerate) banata hai, jo aage reduce ho kar glucose banata hai. Lekin jab patte ke cells mein CO₂ kam aur oxygen zyada ho jaye to rubisco RuBP mein CO₂ ki bajaye O₂ jor deta hai. Is se RuBP do molecules mein toot jata hai: ek phosphoglycerate aur ek phosphoglycolate (do carbon wala molecule).

Phosphoglycolate, glycolate mein badalta hai jo chloroplast se peroxisome mein jata hai. Wahan O₂ ki madad se yeh glyoxylate banta hai; is reaction mein zehreela (toxic) hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) bhi banta hai. Phir glyoxylate, glycine banta hai jo mitochondrion mein jata hai. Wahan glycine ke do molecules mil kar serine ka ek molecule banate hain. Serine wapas peroxisome mein ja kar glycerate banta hai. Peroxisome se glycerate chloroplast mein aata hai aur phosphoglycerate ban jata hai, jo dobara Calvin cycle mein dakhil ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen organelles. Chloroplast mein O2 RuBP se jurti hai, jis se phosphoglycerate (G3P ban kar wapas RuBP) aur phosphoglycolate bante hain; phosphoglycolate H2O le kar aur Pi kho kar glycolate banta hai. Peroxisome mein glycolate O2 istemal kar ke aur H2O2 chhor kar glyoxylate, phir glycine banta hai. Mitochondrion mein glycine se serine banta hai. Serine peroxisome mein wapas aa kar glycerate banta hai, jo phosphoglycerate ke taur par chloroplast mein lautta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.21: Photorespiration ke reactions (kitab ki Figure 5.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab rubisco CO₂ ki bajaye O₂ pakar leta hai to RuBP ka ek hissa do-carbon phosphoglycolate ban jata hai, jise teen organelles se guzar kar wapas phosphoglycerate banana parta hai; is mein carbon (CO₂) aur tawanai zaya hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki chhapi hui figure mein chloroplast ke phosphoglycolate se glycolate wale qadam par H₂O₂ likha hai aur glycerate ka teer phosphoglycolate par khatam hota hai. Durust: is qadam par H₂O lagta hai aur Pi nikalta hai, aur glycerate phosphoglycerate banta hai (jaisa kitab ka apna matan kehta hai). Yahan durust shakal banai gayi hai.
Photorespiration ke nuqsanat

Jo poday carbon fix karne ke liye Calvin cycle istemal karte hain unhein C-3 plants kehte hain. In podon mein photorespiration hone se fix kiye hue carbon ka 25% se 50% zaya ho jata hai, aur paidawar (yield) kam ho jati hai. Photorespiration ki raftar temperature par bhi munhasir hai: zyada temperature par rubisco ka oxygen jorne wala (oxidative) kaam us ke carbon fix karne wale kaam se zyada barh jata hai. Garam (tropical) ilaqon mein, khaas taur par jahan temperature aksar 28 °C se upar rehta hai, yeh masla shadeed hai aur fasalon ki paidawar par bura asar dalta hai.

Jab photosynthesis pehli baar shuru hui to hawa mein oxygen bohat kam thi, is liye photorespiration kam ya bilkul nahin hoti thi. Karoron saal baad hawa mein azaad O₂ jama ho gayi aur rubisco ke ek hi active site ke liye CO₂ aur O₂ mein muqabla shuru ho gaya. Isi se woh masla paida hua jo aaj photorespiration ki shakal mein hai.
Photorespiration ke masle ka hal (adaptations)
Garam ilaqon ke podon ne photorespiration ke masle se bachne ke yeh do tareeqe apnaye (evolve kiye).
C-4 plants C-4 aur C-3 dono qism ki photosynthesis karte hain.
i. C-4 photosynthesis

Kuch poday, jaise ghaas qism ke poday (makai, ganna aur jowar) aur taqreeban do darjan doosre groups, aam Calvin cycle ke saath ek khaas rasta bhi chalate hain jise C-4 photosynthesis kehte hain. In ke patton ke mesophyll cells mein hawa ki jagahein (air spaces) kam hoti hain. Calvin cycle ke enzymes zyada tar khaas cells, bundle-sheath cells, mein hote hain jin mein se CO₂ bahar nahin nikal sakti (impermeable).

blocks.title: C-4 ki qeemat
blocks.text: C-4 photosynthesis mein ek glucose molecule banane ki tawanai ki qeemat taqreeban dugni hai. Lekin garam ilaqon mein, jahan photorespiration warna fix kiye carbon ka aadhe se zyada zaya kar deti, yeh dastiyab behtareen samjhota (compromise) hai.

C-4 photosynthesis (Fig 5.22) mein mesophyll cells ke andar CO₂ ek teen-carbon molecule, phosphoenol pyruvic acid (PEP), se jurti hai. Is se chaar-carbon molecule oxaloacetic acid banta hai. Chunke pehla product 4 carbon wala hai, is liye is amal ko C-4 photosynthesis aur aise podon ko C-4 plants kehte hain. Phir oxaloacetic acid, NADH (kitab ke mutabiq) istemal kar ke, malic acid banta hai. Malic acid saath wale bundle-sheath cell mein jata hai, jahan yeh toot kar pyruvic acid aur CO₂ banata hai. Yeh cells CO₂ ko andar rok lete hain, is liye in mein CO₂ ki concentration barh jati hai aur yeh photorespiration ki bajaye Calvin cycle chalate hain. Bundle-sheath cell mein bana pyruvic acid wapas mesophyll cell mein jata hai aur ek ATP istemal kar ke dobara phosphoenol pyruvic acid ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Baen, C-3 Photosynthesis: mesophyll cell mein CO2 RuBP ke saath Calvin cycle mein jati hai aur sugar nikalti hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.22: C-3 photosynthesis aur C-4 photosynthesis (kitab ki Figure 5.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Baen, C-3 Photosynthesis: mesophyll cell mein CO2 RuBP ke saath Calvin cycle mein jati hai aur sugar nikalti hai. Daen, C-4 Photosynthesis: mesophyll cell mein CO2 phosphoenol pyruvic acid (3-C) se jur kar oxaloacetic acid (4-C) banati hai, jo malic acid (4-C) banta hai; malic acid bundle sheath cell mein ja kar CO2 aur pyruvic acid (3-C) mein toot-ta hai; CO2 RuBP ke saath Calvin cycle mein ja kar sugar banati hai, aur pyruvic acid mesophyll cell mein wapas ja kar dobara phosphoenol pyruvic acid banta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: C-3 poday mein rubisco seedha hawa wali CO₂ pakarta hai, is liye garmi mein O₂ bhi pakar leta hai. C-4 poday mein mesophyll cell pehle CO₂ ko chaar-carbon acid mein band karta hai aur bundle sheath cell mein chhorta hai, jahan CO₂ bohat zyada ho jati hai. Wahan rubisco sirf CO₂ pakarta hai aur photorespiration taqreeban nahin hoti.
CAM metabolism

Garam ilaqon mein bohat se rasdar (succulent) poday, jaise cacti, ananas (pineapple) aur kuch doosre poday, crassulacean acid metabolism ya CAM karte hain (yeh naam podon ke khandan Crassulaceae se aaya jis mein yeh pehli baar daryaft hua). In podon ke stomata raat ko khulte aur din ko band rehte hain. Din mein stomata band rakhne se pani zaya nahin hota aur CO₂ bahar nahin nikalti; CO₂ ki zyada concentration ki wajah se photorespiration kam ho jati hai. Sugar banane ke liye zaroori CO₂ un organic molecules se milti hai jo pichhli raat bane the. C-4 podon ki tarah yeh poday bhi C-4 aur C-3 dono raste istemal karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein “Crassulaceal acid metabolism” chhapa hai; sahi naam crassulacean acid metabolism (CAM) hai, khandan Crassulaceae ke naam par.

Band stomata ke peeche oonchi CO₂ se kam

blocks.prompt: Garam dopahar mein photorespiration bad-tar kyun ho jati hai, aur makai aur cacti har ek is se kaise bachte hain?
blocks.explanation: Oonche darja-hararat par rubisco ki oxidative sargarmi us ki carbon fix karne ki sargarmi se tez barhti hai, aur pani bachane ke liye stomata band hote hain to CO₂ girti aur O₂ jama hoti hai; rubisco phir RuBP mein O₂ shamil karta hai. Makai, ek C-4 poda, mesophyll mein CO₂ ko PEP par fix karta hai aur use malic acid ke taur par bundle-sheath cells tak pohanchata hai, jahan oonchi CO₂ rubisco ko Calvin cycle par rakhti hai. Cacti, CAM poday, apne stomata sirf raat ko kholte hain, CO₂ organic acids mein zakheera karte hain, aur din mein band stomata ke peeche use Calvin cycle ko dete hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Photorespiration: roshni mein, zyada O₂ aur kam CO₂ par, rubisco RuBP mein O₂ shamil karta hai, jis se phosphoglycerate aur phosphoglycolate bante hain; glycolate ka rasta peroxisome (H₂O₂) aur mitochondrion (do glycine se serine, CO₂ nikalti hai) se ho kar glycerate chloroplast ko wapas karta hai. O₂ kharch, CO₂ nikalti hai, ATP nahin.
C-3 poday fix kiye carbon ka 25 se 50 fisad khote hain, 28 degree Celsius se upar bad-tar; masla tab paida hua jab hawa ki O₂ jama ho kar rubisco ke active site ke liye CO₂ se muqabla karne lagi.

C-4 poday (makai, ganna, jowar) mesophyll mein CO₂ ko PEP par fix karte hain (oxaloacetic se malic acid) aur CO₂ na-guzar bundle-sheath cells mein use Calvin cycle ke liye chhorte hain, taqreeban dugni tawanai ki qeemat par. CAM poday (cacti, ananas) raat ko stomata kholte hain, CO₂ organic acids mein zakheera karte hain aur din mein istemal karte hain.
